title: thlaspi capricornutum
intro: Thlaspi capricornutum, commonly known as Alpine Pennycress or Mountain Pennycress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to reduce inflammation, promote healing, and support immune function, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi capricornutum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Thlaspi capricornutum include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
